title: Gears of War turns 20, RAAM is free in E-Day 🪖
subject: gearsofwar
description:
What's your favorite Gears memory? 👇

Xbox marked 20 years of Gears of War on November 6, 2026: RAAM is free as a multiplayer character for every Gears of War: E-Day player, a two-week anniversary event adds limited-time modes like Horde Siege "For the Queen", and E-Day Season 2 "Legacy" starts December 1 with returning maps, modes and skins.

Sources: Xbox Wire, "20 Years of Gears" (Nov 6, 2026)
Game footage © Microsoft / Xbox Game Studios.

scenes.text: Gears of War turns 20 on November 7.
To celebrate, Xbox is giving every Gears of War: E-Day player RAAM as a free multiplayer character. You only have to log in.
A two-week event runs alongside it, with limited-time modes like a Horde Siege variant called For the Queen, where the supply cache is switched off.
It brings back fan-favorite maps, modes and skins, including one called Solemn Memories Dom.
